features.label: WebRTC tests

patches.author: Florian Quèze
patches.subject: Re-enable tests disabled on Linux that pass there on try.

patches.author: Florian Quèze
patches.subject: Re-enable tests disabled on Windows that pass there on try.

patches.author: Jens Stutte
patches.subject: Give dcsctp a real clock by implementing DcSctpSocketCallbacks::Now().

patches.author: Jens Stutte
patches.subject: Use the WebIDL spelling of maxPacketLifeTime in the dcsctp interop test.

patches.author: Andrew Osmond
patches.subject: Part 3. Update media test annotations for Android isolated process.

features.summary: Several WebRTC tests were restored after confirming they pass on Linux and Windows, and test setup was adjusted for Android’s isolated-process model. The changes also improve SCTP data-channel interoperability by using a real clock and the correct WebIDL spelling for `maxPacketLifeTime`.

features.label: Connection transport (ICE / DTLS)

patches.author: Andrew Osmond
patches.subject: Don't create candidate pairs from binding responses on an obsolete ICE stream.

patches.author: stransky
patches.subject: Make nr_crypto_nss_hmac() work with FIPS enabled

features.summary: The ICE connection process now avoids forming candidate pairs from responses tied to an outdated connection stream, reducing the risk of stale network paths being used. WebRTC’s NSS-based HMAC cryptography was also updated to work when FIPS security mode is enabled.

features.label: WebRTC

patches.author: Martin Sirringhaus
patches.subject: Make WebRTC work with FIPS enabled

features.summary: WebRTC’s cryptographic operations were updated to work with FIPS enabled, a security mode that requires approved cryptographic methods. This helps WebRTC function in environments with stricter security requirements.

features.label: WebRTC web API (RTCPeerConnection)

patches.author: Jens Stutte
patches.subject: Skip polling a process for WebRTC stats history while its previous reply is outstanding.

features.summary: Firefox now avoids requesting WebRTC statistics history from a process while an earlier request is still being handled. This prevents overlapping polling requests and helps keep stats collection orderly.

features.label: libwebrtc integration

patches.author: Chun-Min Chang
patches.subject: Reject malformed planar image picture geometry

features.summary: Firefox now rejects planar video images whose picture dimensions or layout are malformed. This prevents invalid image geometry from being passed into libwebrtc, the underlying WebRTC media engine.

patches.subject: Part 3. Update media test annotations for Android isolated process.

patches.subject: Skip the videoOrientation reftests on mingw builds, which disable WebRTC.

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Force-enable tab sharing pref in getUserMedia source telemetry test

patches.author: Michael Froman
patches.subject: Remove reftest-wait even when getDisplayMedia() rejects.

patches.subject: Record the actually granted getUserMedia source

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Make RTCSessionDescription.type/sdp readonly.

patches.author: Anna Weine
patches.subject: Don't send the ML-KEM key share for WebRTC DTLS by default

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Negotiate the dependency descriptor RTP header extension for receiving video.

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Add an interop mochitest for Video Orientation signaling and receive.

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Support Video Orientation RTP header extension: signaling and receive path.

features.summary: WebRTC gained support for signaling and receiving video orientation, and for negotiating the dependency descriptor RTP header extension used to describe video frames. The changes also improve the accuracy and reliability of media sharing, source reporting, and session descriptions, while updating tests for platform-specific behavior. ML-KEM, a newer key-exchange method, is no longer offered in WebRTC’s DTLS handshake by default.

patches.author: Andrew Osmond
patches.subject: Don't create candidate pairs from binding responses on an obsolete ICE stream.

patches.subject: Declare every about:license notice in moz.build

patches.subject: Fix some cases where ICE could get stuck.

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Test-cases for stream removal during ICE.

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Implement DTLS restart.

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Create MediaPacket before firing signals.

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: do not use magic numbers;r=dbaker

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: run clippy on mdns_service;r=dbaker

patches.author: Nicolas Grunbaum
patches.subject: make gecko-profiler optional for mdns_service;r=dbaker

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Stop passing around munged remote candidates.

features.summary: The ICE and DTLS connection setup has been made more robust: Firefox now handles removed or outdated ICE streams more safely, addresses cases where ICE could get stuck, and supports restarting DTLS connections. It also stops passing altered remote network candidates around, while updating the mDNS service and licensing build checks.

patches.subject: Report H264 QP thresholds from WebrtcMediaDataEncoder so libwebrtc's QualityScaler can track it.

patches.author: Dan Baker
patches.subject: Bug 2072400 (MOZ) - Track RTP sources locally in AudioConduit/VideoConduit after libwebrtc removed call-layer GetSources();r=webrtc-reviewers,pehrsons

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Serialize MediaCapabilities encode-support probes through an encoder AllocPolicy.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Add PEMFactory::StrictSupportsAsync and strict WebRTC encode support path for MediaCapabilities.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Add strict create-and-probe WebRTC decode support path for MediaCapabilities.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Replace duplicate WebRTC codec-support pref-gating closures with shared functions.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Route MediaCapabilities WebRTC and encode paths through async codec support.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Handle AV1 when checking for platform decoder.

features.summary: Firefox improved how WebRTC checks whether audio and video codecs are supported, including AV1, by coordinating asynchronous encoder and decoder capability checks with MediaCapabilities, the browser API that reports media support. It also gives libwebrtc better information for video quality adjustment and tracks RTP sources locally after an upstream libwebrtc change.

patches.subject: Only report a capture frame size change when it actually changed.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Plumb H264 profile and level into WebrtcGmpVideoCodec.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Constrain WebRTC video encoder resolution/framerate to the negotiated H264/AV1 level (both codecs).

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Make MediaCapabilities validate AV1 fmtp params.

patches.author: Anna Weine
patches.subject: Update webrtcdtls.KEA to FF 164

features.summary: WebRTC, the technology behind browser video calls, now works with FIPS-enabled security settings and better respects the negotiated H.264 and AV1 video limits, so calls can use compatible video sizes and frame rates. Firefox also reports capture-size changes only when they really happen and updates its DTLS security settings; other patches mainly improve codec capability checks and code quality.

patches.subject: suppress dtls error on ice failures

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Exclude AV1's asymmetric profile fmtp parameter from RTCRtpSender's codec dictionary match.

features.summary: The RTCPeerConnection web API now supports provisional answers (`pranswer`) and handles ICE failures without also reporting a misleading DTLS error. Codec matching was refined for AV1’s asymmetric profile settings, and WebRTC statistics polling now waits for any earlier history request to finish.

features.label: Camera & audio capture

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Apply capture rotation centrally, behind a pref.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Don't swap the requested frame dimensions for rotated frames.

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Add a fake-camera test pattern for pixel-level rotation tests.

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Add media.getusermedia.camera.fake.rotation pref for testing.

features.summary: Camera rotation is now applied in one central place, while keeping the requested video dimensions unchanged. A built-in test pattern and testing preference help verify that rotated camera video appears correctly; these changes are mainly about consistent capture behavior and testing, with no intended visible change for most users.

features.label: Negotiation engine (JSEP)

patches.author: Anna Weine
patches.subject: Reject local descriptions whose DTLS fingerprint was modified

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Populate and correctly negotiate AV1 fmtp parameters in jsep.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Merge directions when an RTP header extension is registered again with a different direction.

features.summary: WebRTC offer-and-answer negotiation now checks that a local description’s DTLS fingerprint—the value used to verify the connection’s peer—has not been altered. It also correctly negotiates AV1 codec format parameters and combines directions when the same RTP header extension is registered more than once.

features.label: Session negotiation (SDP)

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Fix AV1 fmtp profile/level-idx parsing bugs in the sipcc and rsdparsa SDP parsers.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Fix stale AV1 RTP spec anchors in comments.

features.summary: SDP parsing now correctly handles AV1 fmtp profile and level-index parameters in both of Firefox’s WebRTC parsers, improving interoperability with peers that advertise AV1 capabilities. The accompanying documentation references were refreshed; _there is no intended visible change by itself_.

features.label: libwebrtc build

patches.author: Dan Baker
patches.subject: updated default_config_env for v155

patches.author: Dan Baker
patches.subject: updated default_config_env for v154

features.summary: The default build configuration was updated for libwebrtc versions 154 and 155. This keeps Firefox’s build settings aligned with the versions of the WebRTC calling engine it integrates.

features.label: Android camera capture

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Report rotation from the Android capture backend instead of applying it.

features.summary: On Android, the camera capture backend now reports the camera’s rotation directly instead of Firefox rotating the frames afterward. This keeps orientation information tied to the platform source and avoids duplicate or inconsistent rotation handling.

features.label: Libwebrtc Overrides

patches.author: Jens Stutte
patches.subject: Use std::source_location in WebrtcLocation.

features.summary: WebRTC’s diagnostic location information now uses C++ std::source_location, allowing source file and line details to be captured by the language rather than maintained through custom arguments. This is an internal reliability and maintainability improvement with no expected user-facing change.

features.label: Transportbridge

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Handle MediaTrackGraph promises on AbstractThread::MainThread().

features.summary: Media-track operations now handle their completion signals on the browser’s main thread, where they can be coordinated safely with other browser activity. This is an internal reliability change, with no intended visible change for users.

features.label: Video Engine

patches.author: Jan-Ivar Bruaroey
patches.subject: Store desktop capture sources in an nsTArray instead of a map.

features.summary: The video engine’s internal storage for desktop capture sources was changed. This is an implementation detail, with no user-visible behavior change indicated by the patch title.
